1949, August 9
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana August 9 '49.
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you Brother Leo: you and yours including if we may, also poor, poor Fr. Solanus.
I just received your charitable letter and will be pleased to juin with yourself and your friends across Meldrom in praying for poor dear little "Granma Kauffman. Sorry I did not know of her trouble before she went to the hospital . . . Diluted creolin, say 2 to 4 tablespoonfuls to a pint of water will give wonerful relief by simply sponging the parts effected once over, every two or three hours. or every 4 or 5 or more hours.
Several years ago, before I got acquainte with mistress creoin, I applied the pure stuff to quite some patches of No. i's area and very shortly - for a couple of minutes - I began to rather fear I'd possible made a fearful mistake - It made thins so hot for me. It was a good lesson without the least injury. Few doctors seem to know about this remedy; so simple !=
Now; Dear Br. Leo: I've had a big problem on my mind for over a year. - have spoken about it to Fr. Provincial and to sev- eral religious friends, asking their prayers, etc.
I started months ago to write F. Provincial particulars about and am still trying to get it off. Of course it is not easy to write important lines of any kind without study and practice, at least for me ..... To-day of sixteen letters received there were ten personals, which leaves me very little time, so that often it is not easy to what to do. On an average there about a dozen letter per day. In Father Blase's absence - otherwise too - Brother Raphael attends to many of the letters we get here concerning the Ser. Mass Assoc'n. . So please pray
Best regard and God's blessing to all the Novices and Candidate & of course all in the Monastery and your dear Parents, etc. Just herein, viz, in praying for success of good works and undertakings the novices and candidates can fall in line as practical religions and Capuchins before-hand.
God Bless you all again,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
